mapper.insert: insert into builder.adk_builder_dev_request_receipt (dev_request_id, returned_head, outcome, receive_commit, test_rows, rejections, account_id) values (#{receipt.devRequestId}, #{receipt.returnedHead}, #{receipt.outcome}, #{receipt.receiveCommit}, #{receipt.testRows}, #{receipt.rejections}, #{receipt.accountId})
mapper.select: select id, dev_request_id, returned_head, outcome, receive_commit, test_rows, rejections, account_id, received_at from builder.adk_builder_dev_request_receipt where dev_request_id = #{devRequestId} order by id desc
